edges.reason: Constructor assigns _treasury to the treasury state variable.
Constructor assigns _sMNFST to the sMNFST state variable.
Constructor parameter _treasury flows into constructor assignment.
Constructor parameter _sMNFST flows into constructor assignment.
Constructor parameter _uri flows into ERC1155 base constructor.
setTreasury parameter feeds the function body.
setTreasury writes the treasury state variable.
setsMNFST parameter feeds the function body.
setsMNFST writes the sMNFST state variable.
toggleSaleIsActive flips the saleIsActive flag.
toggleSaleIsActive reads the sMNFST address for a balance check.
toggleSaleIsActive reads totalRemaining1 in the required balance computation.
toggleSaleIsActive reads totalRemaining2 in the required balance computation.
toggleSaleIsActive reads totalRemaining3 in the required balance computation.
addWhitelistToken parameter _address feeds the function body.
addWhitelistToken parameter _isEnabled feeds the function body.
addWhitelistToken reads and writes tokenWhitelistInfo entries.
addWhitelistAddress calldata array feeds the loop.
addWhitelistAddress writes the addressEligible mapping.
randMod parameter _modulus used in the modulo operation.
randMod seeds randomness with the caller-controlled msg.sender.
randMod seeds randomness with miner-influenced block.timestamp.
randMod reads and increments the randNonce state variable.
randMod's predictable keccak seed constitutes weak randomness.
mint parameter _numHoodies controls loop count and payment check.
mint trusts msg.sender for wallet cap, eligibility and payout recipient.
mint requires saleIsActive to be true.
mint reads price to validate the sent ether.
mint reads and updates totalClaimed for the caller.
mint reads and decrements totalRemaining1.
mint reads and decrements totalRemaining2.
mint reads and decrements totalRemaining3.
mint reads the sMNFST address for the reward transfer.
mint calls randMod inside its selection loop.
The randMod result is assigned to local hoodieNum in mint.
mint computes price * _numHoodies for the payment requirement.
mint mutates totalRemaining counters via arithmetic decrements.
mint relies on the weak randMod output for hoodie distribution, enabling timestamp/randomness manipulation.
mint performs an external IERC20 sMNFST transfer to the caller.
mint invokes _mintBatch to create tokens.
_mintBatch triggers receiver acceptance callbacks on the caller-controlled recipient address.
setURI parameter _newUri feeds the function body.
setPrice parameter inPrice feeds the function body.
setPrice writes the price state variable.
checkSaleEligiblity parameter _address is checked against whitelists.
checkSaleEligiblity iterates over tokenWhitelistInfo entries.
checkSaleEligiblity reads the addressEligible mapping.
totalClaimedBy parameter owner indexes the totalClaimed mapping.
totalClaimedBy reads totalClaimed for the given owner.
totalSupply parameter _id selects the hoodie token branch.
totalSupply reads totalRemaining1 for supply computation.
totalSupply reads totalRemaining2 for supply computation.
totalSupply reads totalRemaining3 for supply computation.
totalHoodiesMinted reads treasuryHasMinted to add the treasury allocation.
totalHoodiesMinted reads totalRemaining1.
totalHoodiesMinted reads totalRemaining2.
totalHoodiesMinted reads totalRemaining3.

mintToTreasury reads and sets treasuryHasMinted.
mintToTreasury mints tokens to the treasury address.
withdrawAllEth assigns the contract balance to local balance.
withdrawAllEth forwards the entire balance via a low-level call to treasury.
withdrawAllEth reads the treasury destination address.
The low-level value call transfers control to the treasury address, enabling reentrancy if that address is a contract.
withdrawAllsMNFST requires saleIsActive to be false.
withdrawAllsMNFST reads the sMNFST address for balance and transfer.
withdrawAllsMNFST transfers the sMNFST balance to treasury.
Local totals array aggregates mint counts consumed by the mint flow.
Local hoodieNum drives branch selection inside mint.
